Bholānātha
poet. q. in Vidyākarasahasraka v. 750.

Bholānātha
son of Mādhava, an. ancestor of Nṛsiṃha (a. of C. on Dhātupāṭha from Saṃkṣiptasāra, IO. 839).

Bholānātha
preceptor of Mīnanātha (a. of Yogasaṅgraha, RORI. IV. 2160 (inc.)).

Bholānātha
(probably a compiler).
-Karuṇālaharī (in a collection). RORI. XXII. 1706. C.. the text.
-Govindastuti (in a collection). RORI. XXII. 1706.
-Govindāṣṭaka. RORI. XXII. 1300. [Page280a]
-Prabhāka(ra)-prītaye-padyāvalī (in a collection). RORI. XXII. 1706.
-Lāvaṇyalaharī (in a collection). RORI. XXII. 1706.

Bholānātha
son of Nandarāma an. grandson of Ratneśa (but some mss. mention a. son of Ratneśa) an. a. protege of Sawai Pratap Singh of Jaipur.
-Karṇakutūhala. nāṭaka. RORI. II. B. 4101.
Pt.. Rajasthan Ori. Ser. 26., Jaipur, 1957.
-Kṛṣṇalīlā(mṛta). in 104 v.. RORI. II. B. 4093. XXII. 1876 (inc.).
Pt.. Rajasthan Purātana Granthamālā 26, Jodhpur, 1957.
For more ref. see under the text.

Bholānātha
a vaiṣṇava Brahmin of Ṭikurī.
-Pānthadūta in 105 Śārdūlavikrīḍita v.. regarding message to Kṛṣṇa from Gopīs. IO. 3890.
See Jaina Sid. Bhāṣ. II. ii. p. 61. [Page280b]
-C. Sandarbhāmṛtatoṣiṇī on Mugdhabodha. IO. 871.

Bholānātha
-C. on Śrutabodha. SB. New D.. XI. 44104.

Bholānātha(brahmacārin)
wrote a. the instance of Prāṇa Kṛṣṇaviśvāsa (1764-1834 A. D.). of a village near Calcutta.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1201b.
-Vaiṣṇavāmṛta. tantra. BHU. 3667 (ºsaṅgraha). IM. 2732. L. 563. 2119. S. K. Ray 168-69. S. K. Ray D.. 215. Vaṅgīya p. 226 (inc.).

Bholānāthaśarman
-C. Sthūlatātparyanirṇaya on Vāsavadattā of Subandhu. IO. 4080.
